summary_en: Full-year dividend per share raised by ¥3 from prior forecast; Q2 interim dividend unchanged; year-end dividend increased to ¥5 from ¥2 forecast. Full-year per-share dividend now ¥7. Revision reflects upward adjustment to consolidated net income forecast for FY3/25 (ended March 31, 2025), driven by higher-than-expected gains on loans at subsidiary Juroku Bank.
title_en: Notice of revision to performance forecast and dividend forecast (dividend increase) for fiscal year ended March 31, 2025
translation_en_brief:
Juroku Financial Group announced an upward revision to its full-year dividend forecast for FY3/25 (fiscal year ended March 31, 2025). The company increased the year-end dividend per share to ¥5 from a prior forecast of ¥2, while holding the Q2 interim dividend unchanged. As a result, full-year dividend per share is now projected at ¥7, representing a ¥3 increase from the prior forecast.

The revision was triggered by an upward adjustment to consolidated net income guidance for FY3/25. Subsidiary Juroku Bank is expected to generate loan-related gains higher than previously anticipated. The company notes that the prior-period actual full-year dividend for FY3/24 was ¥5 per share. The disclosure also references a stock split (1:5) effective April 1, 2024, adjusting per-share metrics accordingly.
